ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution of approximately 40% high-intensity pixels (white) to 60% low-intensity pixels (black) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity patches are located medially on both fluke lobes. A central low-intensity band separates the lobes. High-contrast dark linear marks are embedded within the high-intensity patch of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary exhibits high-frequency jagged variations. Peak-to-valley pixel-amplitudes range from 5 to 20 pixels, distributed irregularly across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broad concave curve toward the median notch, while the lateral tips exhibit a pronounced convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groups are localized on the extreme distal-lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with epibiont attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cross the high-intensity medial zones. A prominent intersecting pair of linear marks forms a distinct 'A' shape on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear physical trauma marks (rake marks) across the central lobes and significant barnacle colonization on the distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: The geometric configuration of dark abrasions on the right lobe forms a highly unique alphanumeric-like 'A' pattern.
